# netbox_permission (Resource)

Manages a NetBox permission (`/api/users/permissions/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_permission" "example" {
  name = "example"
  object_types = []
  actions = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Set of String) The list of actions granted by this permission.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object Types.

### Optional

- `constraints` (String) Queryset filter matching the applicable objects of the selected type(s).
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Group (`netbox_user_group`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned User (`netbox_user`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_permission can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_permission.example 123
```
